versions.description_html:
Learn Azure Resource Graph in plain language. Discover how to query, filter, and inventory thousands of cloud resources using Kusto Query Language.

Azure Resource Graph is a service inside Azure that lets you ask questions about your resources and get fast answers, even when you have thousands of them. The name sounds heavier than the thing really is.In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What Azure Resource Graph Actually Is
  • Why the Normal Way of Asking Azure Breaks Down
  • The Query Language, Explained Without the Scary Parts
  • Your First Query in Resource Graph Explorer
  • What People Actually Use It For
  • The Limits Nobody Warns You About
  • A Quick Recap and One Question For You
Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
